summary: The AI-Powered Data Engineer leverages generative AI and machine learning to optimize data pipelines, perform predictive transformations, and enhance analytics capabilities.
responsibilities: Build intelligent data pipelines with AI-assisted transformations
Implement predictive data quality and anomaly detection systems
Integrate AI services into ETL/ELT workflows
Collaborate with ML and analytics teams to enhance data-driven insights
Optimize AI-assisted data workflows for performance and cost

education: 4–8 years of experience in data engineering and AI integration

skills_required.name: Knowledge of generative AI tools and ML pipelines
Programming in Python, Java, or Scala
Experience with Spark, Hadoop, or cloud data platforms
Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle integration with data systems
